project_title: MIRRORS 96 Cymascope Settings Live Preview Blueprint
instructions_to_main_agent: No code execution required for this task - blueprint specification only.
Target implementation file structure uses React Native / Web Canvas compatibility in JS/JSX components.
Implement paired live preview cards inside Scope settings modal/panel without rewriting existing Scope controls.
Default scope mode remains SOLID unless user taps PLATE or DISC preview card.
Keep Home logo positioned above the main Scope viewport.
Ensure all interactive preview cards, readouts, and mode toggles include testable data-testid attributes.

paired_cards_layout.container_style: flex row gap-3 justify-center items-center my-3 px-2

realtime_audio_mapping.hz_to_modes: n = clamp(floor(Hz / 60), 1, 12), m = clamp(floor(Hz / 90), 1, 12), k = clamp(floor(Hz / 120), 1, 8)
realtime_audio_mapping.idle_state: Render static reference nodal geometry (e.g. n=3, m=5) at 40% opacity with 'IDLE / READY' indicator when audio session is inactive.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Always maintain #05060c deep obsidian background for all cymascope surfaces.
Keep nodal line glow dual-tinted with red (#ff3b30) and teal-white (#22d3ee / #ffffff).
Tap on either paired preview card updates the active scope mode preference and highlights card with 1.5px cyan border + glow.
Do not break or remove existing Lab, music streaming, or ScopeNode panel controls.
Ensure static reference rendering is shown when idle instead of simulated fake live motion.
All interactive elements MUST include explicit data-testid attributes.
